parsed.title: AOL Ad-Free Sprint
parsed.oneLiner: Enjoy 15 minutes of ad-free news reading after a quick game.

economy: AD TODAY native on Home News Feed (e47)
AD TODAY banner on Article Detail Page (e22)

newMechanic.name: Ad-free Sprint
newMechanic.description: A time-boxed entitlement that suppresses all native Taboola ads and banner advertisements across news feeds and article pages.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: The app features high ad density without a path for users to earn a cleaner reading experience through a value exchange.

parsed.trigger: A promotional card appears in the Home News Feed after the user scrolls past the first two articles.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying users currently exposed to standard native and banner ad density.

offer.title: Go Ad-Free for 15 Minutes
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with AOL to clear all ads from your news feed for a short sprint.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The 15-minute window is strictly time-boxed to provide a sampling effect of a premium experience without replacing potential long-term ad-free subscriptions.

guardrails: Total native ad impressions per DAU

risks: Users may wait for sprint availability rather than browsing during standard ad density.
Small risk of JARring return to ads at the end of the 15-minute window.

newElements.change: An inline feed card titled 'Ad-Free Sprint' with a 'Play to Clear Ads' button.
A countdown timer badge next to the 'Home' title showing remaining ad-free time.
A sidebar menu item 'Ad-Free Sprint (15 min)' to provide a secondary hub entry point.
